liz: Anyone have final SSO attribute mapping + RBAC evidence for the Stripe POC? SIG asked for proof we enforce least-privilege and a full SAML attribute list. POC kickoff Thurs. Also pricing Q from buyer re: burst capacity pricing. cc @anya

anya: On it. I'll pull the SAML metadata and the role mapping doc. For pricing, can you forward the buyer's exact ask?

liz: They want max qps/burst pricing + what happens if they exceed reserved capacity. Also need an explicit statement that MFA enforced for all org admins.

sam: We have an artifact in the deal folder: SSO_and_RBAC_Evidence_v2.pdf. Key points:
- Enforced SSO via SAML/Okta
- MFA required for org-admins via IdP policy
- RBAC = scoped roles + least-privilege defaults
I'll paste the attribute mapping snippet here.

sam:
```
SAML Attribute Mapping (Okta):
- NameID -> user.email
- firstName -> user.firstName
- lastName -> user.lastName
- groups -> user.groups
- adminLevel -> user.custom.admin_level
```

raj: Adding the role-binding sample and control excerpt from security controls (sec-control-4.2):

raj:
```
{
  "role": "project.viewer",
  "bindings": [
    { "principal": "group:dev-team@example.com", "condition": "resource.startsWith('proj-')" }
  ],
  "least_privilege": true
}
```

liz: Can we convert the role binding sample into a one-page statement for SIG? They want a yes/no checklist + evidence links.

anya: Yes. I'll draft a cover letter + checklist by EOD. For pricing: Dedicated burst above committed capacity is billed at 1.8x of the committed unit price for sustained bursts >5min; on-demand capacity is billed at standard on-demand rate. I'll confirm exact $ units and add to the doc.

raj: Note: MFA enforcement for org admins is enforced at the IdP via conditional access; we don't provision MFA ourselves for SSO accounts. For local console/service emergency accounts we require 2FA + key rotation as per policy.
